title: Kubo-Ando Means of Finite Order over Real Division Algebras
summary: In this paper, we study Kubo-Ando means of finite order over the real division algebras $\mathbb{R}$, $\mathbb{C}$, and $\mathbb{H}$. We establish an explicit bijection between Kubo-Ando means of order $n$ and normalized positive functions $f$ such that both $f$ and its transpose $f^{\top}(t)=tf(t^{-1})$ are matrix monotone of order $n$. We also prove that matrix monotonicity of a fixed order is independent of the underlying division algebra. We then investigate finite-order Kubo-Ando means under the canonical embeddings relating quaternionic, complex, and real positive definite matrices.…
